One thing isn't certain. Tobias called it "Tobias's dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks. That note doesn't say who took the account over. So I suggested Pree quickly check with Tobias before the customer call.

Pree is in that channel, and ticket numbers are operational details rather than finance figures, so nothing needed approval.
